data.name: Hemant
data.gender_notes: Hemant is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit hima, 'snow, cold' — hemanta, 'early winter'. Its root is Sanskrit hima (हिम). A classical Sanskrit name for the winter season. Hemant is a Sanskrit name meaning “Winter; early winter”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hemant expresses “Winter; early winter”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit hima, 'snow, cold' — hemanta, 'early winter'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemant total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
